rules.sentence: Chronic inflammatory demyelinating neuropathy: Corticosteroids are used to treat this neuropathy initially but can also be treated using intravenous immunoglobulin, plasma exchange, and some immunosuppressant drugs.
Literature suggests that idiopathic sensory neuropathy is a diagnosis of exclusion and that there may be an autoimmune component of the pathophysiology behind the disease.[38]
Other diseases that may present in a similar clinical fashion include distal acquired demyelinating symmetric neuropathy and sensory chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy.
